newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Azores Christmas storms cost $20 million in damage.
newsitem.headline: Azores Christmas storms cost $20 million in damage.

text.p: Violent storms that lashed the mid-Atlantic Azores Islands over Christmas caused over $20 million worth of damage to harbours, houses and roads, local officials said.

Regional government president Carlos Cesare told a news conference late on Thursday that the havoc wrought by 95 miles (150 km) an hour gales on Christmas Day took the total bill for storm damage suffered over the past month to over $60 million, the Lusa news agency reported.
The Portuguese cabinet was expected to approve a package of emergency aid for the Azores at a meeting on Friday.
Damage to the harbour at Ponta Delgada, the islands' capital, battered by boats that broke free of their moorings on Christmas Day, was alone put at some $10 million, local officials said.
Nobody was injured in the storms but 20 families were forced to flee when their homes were flooded.
